rule.description: The rule id, e.g. MS-BOUND-001 or MS-ALLOC-003

cwe.description: The CWE the rule maps to, e.g. CWE-787

file.description: The finding's file: the analysed input's name in front of a path inside it, or an absolute path for a file outside it

line.description: The finding's line, 1-based; 0 when the node carries no position

column.description: The finding's column, 1-based; 0 when the node carries no position

severity.description: One of critical, high, medium, low

message.description: The offending code and the rule's message, with the notes the rule adds

function.description: The full name of the method the finding sits in; empty when there is none

purl.description: The package URL of the BOM component that owns the finding's file (cdx:vendored:path, cdx:cmake:sourceDir). Present only when a located component owns the file; a path named only by the --external-paths pattern has no purl

flow.description: The evidence chain: the offending node, its memory operation, the origin, guard and extent facts the rule read, and the definitions that produced the value

fingerprint.description: SHA-256, as lowercase hex, over the UTF-8 bytes of the string rule|function|file|apis: the rule id, the rendered function and file values, and the ordered distinct names of the finding's memory-operation calls joined with , (empty when there are none). The line and the column are not part of it, so the fingerprint survives edits that move the finding within its function. In SARIF output the same value rides under partialFingerprints as atom/memorySafety/v1

atom.description: The path of the atom file the finding was rendered from

instances.description: The template-args of each instantiation that shares this finding, present only on a finding of a template instance that other instances share

MemorySafetyFinding.title: Memory-safety finding
MemorySafetyFinding.description: One finding of atom's memory-safety command, as the json format writes it. The command writes a JSON array of these objects

file.description: The step's file: relative to the analysed input without its name in front, or absolute for a file outside it

code.description: The step's code, or the text of a fact the rule read

role.description: One of length-argument, memory-operation, exit, origin, guard, destination, definition
